# environment-shot (reference summary)

## Purpose
Plan a wide environment / establishing-shot scene (locale, time of day, weather, focal subject, depth, atmosphere) before any modeling or render attempt.

Translate a wide place-establishing intent (locale, time of day, weather, atmosphere, foreground/midground/background depth layers, and focal subject or explicit "none") into a structured scene plan with an explicit assumptions register. Distinct from `character-portrait` (single subject), `product-hero-scene-planner` (manufactured products), and `interior-scene` (interior rooms/furniture/surfaces — an establishing shot of an interior room belongs there when furniture or surfaces dominate). Hands off asset rows to `asset-discovery` and validation to `composition-quality-checker`, `lighting-quality-checker`, and `scene-readiness`.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/environment-shot/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/environment-shot/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `scene-planners` / `environment-establishing-shot-architect`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- intent is establishing a wide place (landscape, cityscape, outdoor locale, or wide interior space where furniture/surfaces do not dominate)
- before any modeling, Geometry Nodes, or scene building
- when consumer is editorial, cinematic, or brand

## Trigger cues
- "establishing shot of"
- "wide shot of"
- "city / forest / desert / ocean scene"
- "set the scene"

## When not to use
- character portrait → delegate to `character-portrait` (`references/skills/character-portrait.md`; use character-portrait)
- product hero → delegate to `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skills/product-hero-scene-planner.md`; use product-hero-scene-planner)
- interior arch viz with focus on furniture / surfaces → delegate to `interior-scene` (`references/skills/interior-scene.md`; use interior-scene)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `locked_3d_brief` (`object`): Locked 3D brief specifying locale, mood, focal anchor, and delivery channel
- `atmosphere_and_time_of_day` (`object`): Target time of day, weather condition, and atmospheric haze/fog parameters

### Optional inputs
- `asset_discovery_constraints` (`object`): Available environment kitbash or terrain assets from asset-discovery

### Primary outputs
- `foreground_midground_background_layer_plan`
- `sun_sky_atmosphere_specification`
- `horizon_and_scale_anchor_plan`

## Quick-start procedure
1. confirm upstream brief from `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` and verify a realizable (non-invented) locale scope
2. pin locale, time of day, weather, and atmosphere
3. pin foreground (FG), midground (MG), and background (BG) depth layers
4. pin focal subject (or explicitly declare `none`)
5. record an explicit assumptions register
6. flag asset rows for `asset-discovery` and emit validation handoffs with `Runtime status: Not Run` and `Artifact status: Not Produced`

## Handoff notes
- **[upstream_reference]** Brief writer → `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skills/intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`) — `when.all: [goal.clarity equals "clear"; brief.locked equals false]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Asset discovery → `asset-discovery` (`references/skills/asset-discovery.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; assets.discoveryComplete equals false]`
- **[progression]** Composition validation → `composition-quality-checker` (`references/skills/composition-quality-checker.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "composition"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[progression]** Lighting validation → `lighting-quality-checker` (`references/skills/lighting-quality-checker.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "lighting"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[progression]** Quality readiness → `scene-readiness` (`references/skills/scene-readiness.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "holistic"; stage.current equals "quality_validation"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Planning-only skill: no modeling, no Geometry Nodes, no render, and no Blender execution. `Runtime status` stays `Not Run` and `Artifact status` stays `Not Produced` (downgrade-only, never upgrade). If the brief or locale scope is unclear, hand off to `intent-to-3d-brief-writer`.
- Model the environment.
- Generate Geometry Node setups.
- Render.
- Run Blender.
